asks: Do you know if it's still cold out?
Would you say I look all right in this?
description: A brown bear sits back on its haunches in a heavy, well-cut coat, taking up more of the room than anything in the room ought to, and it's being extremely polite about it.
emotes: {it} adjusts the coat at the shoulder with a hooked claw and settles again.
{it} yawns, which takes a while, and shuts its mouth with a clop.
{it} shifts, and the whole room seems to get one size smaller.
looks: The coat has been let out at the shoulders by somebody who knew what they were doing.
It smells of wet wool and something underneath the wet wool.
Its eyes are small and brown and considerably more patient than yours.
name: a bear in a good coat
says: Take your time. I have nowhere else.
It's warmer in here. Stay as long as you need.
I would shake hands but you wouldn't enjoy it.
